description: Update an existing user’s identity or client trust settings. Uses Backend API validation. Null clears nullable string fields; omitted fields stay unchanged. Passwords, credential inputs and metadata are rejected. Returns selected safe user fields. dry_run previews only the approved changes without updating the user.

instance.description: Instance to target: "development", "production", or a full instance ID (ins_…).

workspace.description: The workspace to act in, as its ID or name. A workspace is the Clerk Dashboard organization that owns the applications, not an Organization inside an application (those go in `organization_id` on the tools that have it). Only needed when this connection covers several workspaces; the error for a missing choice lists them.
